# Trusted Properties

> Bengaluru property information and enquiry website covering 18 properties from SOBHA, Puravankara, Provident and DNR Group.

Trusted Properties is an independent multi-developer platform, not an official developer website. All prices and completion dates are indicative information from the linked project sources, not live quotations or verified inventory. Visuals are illustrative.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://trustedproperties.net/): Overview, imagery and enquiry form.
- [All Bengaluru properties](https://trustedproperties.net/properties/): Compare every listed project.
- [Property FAQs](https://trustedproperties.net/faqs/): Pricing, configurations, plots, timelines and enquiry information.
- [Property films](https://trustedproperties.net/films/): Eight supplied reference videos.

## Source and text versions

- [Source project guide](https://trustedproperties.net/project-guide.pdf): Supplied SOBHA reference; current details must be confirmed.
- [Full text collection](https://trustedproperties.net/llms-full.txt): Project facts and FAQ answers in one file.
- [Project data](https://trustedproperties.net/data/projects.json): Machine-readable facts and canonical links.
- [Home in Markdown](https://trustedproperties.net/index.md): Text version of the overview.
- [Privacy notice](https://trustedproperties.net/privacy/): Form data and contact consent.

Project pages also have Markdown versions at their canonical directory URL followed by index.md. These text versions describe the same facts available to visitors.
